jp-20260822-news-1.title: Rice Wholesale Prices Continue Falling: 2025 Production at Half Last Autumn's Level, 2026 Production Preliminary Prices Expected Down 20-40%

segments.src: ## 止まらぬ下落、主要銘柄は昨秋の半値に
segments.tr: ## Unstoppable Decline: Major Varieties at Half of Last Autumn's Prices

segments.src: 卸業者の間で取引されるコメの価格下落に歯止めがかからない状況が続いている。2025年産の主要銘柄は、価格が高騰していた前年秋の水準と比べて、ほぼ半値まで下落したとみられている。
segments.tr: The downward pressure on rice prices traded among wholesale dealers continues unabated. Major varieties of 2025 production are believed to have fallen to roughly half the price level of the previous autumn, when prices had surged.

segments.src: 一時は「令和のコメ不足」と呼ばれるほど品薄感が強まり価格が急騰した反動もあり、ここにきて需給バランスが大きく緩和方向に振れている。生産者や集荷業者の間では「昨年とは別の作物かと思うほどの価格差」との声も聞かれ、市場の急激な変化に戸惑いが広がっている。
segments.tr: As a rebound from the sharp surge in prices when rice scarcity—referred to as a "Reiwa-era rice shortage"—became severe, supply-demand balance has shifted significantly toward easing. Among producers and collection dealers, voices are heard saying "the price difference is so great it feels like a different crop from last year," and confusion over the market's sharp changes is spreading.

segments.src: ## 26年産の概算金も前年比2〜4割減
segments.tr: ## 2026 Production Preliminary Prices Expected Down 20-40% Year-on-Year

segments.src: JAグループが提示する26年産米の概算金(仮渡金・前払い金)についても、前年産と比べて2〜4割程度低い水準になる見込みだ。概算金は収穫前に生産者へ支払われる仮払い額で、その後の販売実績に応じて追加で精算される仕組みだが、出発点となる金額そのものが大きく切り下げられた形となる。
segments.tr: The preliminary prices (advance payments) for 2026 rice presented by JA Group are also expected to be 20-40% lower than the previous year's production. Preliminary prices are advance payment amounts disbursed to producers before harvest and then further adjusted based on subsequent sales results, but the starting amount itself has been significantly reduced.

segments.src: 前年は歴史的な高値水準だっただけに下げ幅は大きく映るものの、平年と比較した水準感については地域や銘柄によって受け止め方に差があるとされる。いずれにせよ、生産現場にとっては収入の先行きが見通しにくい状況となっている。
segments.tr: While the decline appears large given last year's historically high price level, it is said that understanding of the level compared to normal years differs by region and variety. In any case, for production sites, the outlook for future income has become difficult to predict.

segments.src: ## 在庫を抱える現場では「赤字覚悟」の販売も
segments.tr: ## Production Sites Holding Inventory Consider "Break-Even-or-Loss" Sales

segments.src: 流通段階では在庫の滞留が指摘されており、一部の生産者・集荷業者では採算を度外視した安売りに動く動きも出ているという。価格下落局面では、少しでも早く在庫を現金化したいという心理が働きやすく、それがさらなる値崩れを招く悪循環につながりかねないとの懸念も出ている。
segments.tr: Inventory buildup has been noted in the distribution stage, and some producers and collection dealers have begun moving to discounted sales disregarding profitability. During price declines, the psychology to convert inventory to cash as quickly as possible tends to dominate, and there are concerns that this could lead to a vicious cycle of further price deterioration.

segments.src: - 前年産の高騰を受けた作付け拡大や増産傾向
segments.tr: - Expansion of planting area and increased production tendencies in response to the previous year's price surge

segments.src: - 政府備蓄米の放出などによる流通量の増加
segments.tr: - Increased circulation volume due to the release of government stockpiled rice and other factors

segments.src: - 高値が続いたことによる消費者の「コメ離れ」や節約志向
segments.tr: - Consumer shift away from rice and economizing behavior due to sustained high prices

segments.src: といった複数の要因が重なっているとの見方がある。
segments.tr: It is believed that multiple factors such as these are interacting.

segments.src: コメ価格の乱高下は、生産者の経営計画だけでなく、外食・中食産業のコスト構造や家計の食費にも影響を及ぼす。今後は、需給バランスの安定化に向けた在庫調整のペースや、26年産の作付け動向、政府の備蓄米運用方針などが焦点になりそうだ。急激な価格変動が生産意欲の低下を招けば、中長期的な供給の不安定化につながるおそれもあり、価格と需給の両面で落ち着きどころを探る局面が続くとみられる。
segments.tr: Rice price volatility affects not only producers' management plans but also the cost structures of food service and quick-serve industries and household food budgets. Going forward, the pace of inventory adjustment toward stabilizing supply-demand balance, trends in 2026 production planting, and the government's stockpiled rice management policy will likely become focal points. If sharp price fluctuations lead to a decline in production motivation, there is a risk of medium to long-term supply instability, and it appears that phases of seeking equilibrium from both price and supply-demand perspectives will continue.

jp-20260822-news-3.title: New Market for Unlisted Stock Trading: Financial Services Agency Registers SmartRound as Specialist Securities Company

segments.src: ## 金融庁がスマートラウンドを登録
金融庁は8月21日、未上場株式の売買を仲介する「特定投資家向け株式等の取扱業者」として、スタートアップ支援サービスを手がけるスマートラウンドを登録したと発表した。これにより同社は、上場していないスタートアップ企業の株式を専門的に取り扱う証券会社としての活動を始められることになる。
segments.tr: On August 21, the Financial Services Agency announced the registration of SmartRound, which provides startup support services, as a "Qualified Investor-Focused Securities Handler" for intermediating transactions of unlisted stocks. This enables the company to begin operations as a specialist securities company handling shares of non-listed startup enterprises.

segments.src: これまで未上場企業の株式は、証券取引所のような公開市場で自由に売買する仕組みが乏しく、保有する株式を現金化する手段が限られていた。役職員がストックオプションなどで取得した株式や、投資家が保有する株式を売却したい場合でも、相対での交渉に頼らざるを得ない場面が多かったとされる。
segments.tr: Until now, unlisted company stocks lacked mechanisms for free trading in public markets like stock exchanges, limiting means to liquidate holdings. Even when executives and employees wished to sell shares acquired through stock options or when investors wanted to sell their holdings, they often had to rely on bilateral negotiations.

segments.src: 今回の登録は、こうした未上場株式を対象にした「セカンダリー市場」、いわゆる二次流通市場の整備に向けた動きの一つで、年内をめどに具体的な取引の仕組みが立ち上がる見通しとされている。取引には一定の資力や知識を持つ「特定投資家」など、参加者の範囲が定められる制度設計になっている点が特徴だ。
segments.tr: This registration is one step toward establishing a "secondary market" for such unlisted stocks—a secondary distribution market—with concrete trading mechanisms expected to be established by year-end. A distinctive feature is the institutional design that restricts participants to "Qualified Investors" and others with sufficient financial capacity and knowledge.

segments.src: ## 政府がこの分野を後押しする理由
segments.tr: ## Why the Government Is Supporting This Sector

segments.src: 政府はこれまで、企業価値10億ドル以上の未上場企業を指す「ユニコーン」の創出数で他国に後れを取っているとの課題意識を示してきた。未上場株式を売買しやすくすることで、創業者や従業員、投資家が投資回収をしやすくなり、新たな起業やスタートアップへの資金供給が活発になる効果が期待されている。金融庁による専門証券会社の登録制度は、こうした環境整備の一環と位置付けられている。
segments.tr: The government has previously expressed concern about trailing behind other nations in the number of "unicorns"—unlisted companies valued at over $1 billion. By making unlisted stock trading easier, it is expected that founders, employees, and investors will more readily recover investments, spurring more active funding for new ventures and startups. The Financial Services Agency's specialist securities company registration system is positioned as part of this infrastructure development.
## Key Points to Watch Going Forward

segments.src: 制度の運用開始後は、実際にどの程度の取引が成立し、価格形成が円滑に進むかが焦点となる。未上場株式は上場株式に比べて情報開示の水準や流動性が異なるため、参加する投資家には相応の知識やリスク理解が求められる。今後、金融庁や業界団体からの詳細なルール整備、他の事業者の参入動向にも注目が集まりそうだ。
segments.tr: After the system begins operations, focus will be on how much trading actually materializes and how smoothly price discovery proceeds. Since unlisted stocks differ from listed stocks in terms of information disclosure standards and liquidity, participating investors will need appropriate knowledge and risk understanding. Attention is likely to concentrate on detailed rule-making from the Financial Services Agency and industry organizations, as well as trends in entry by other market participants.

jp-20260822-news-2.title: METI's FY2026 Initial Budget Request: Approximately 7.7 Trillion Yen, with Priority Allocation to AI, Semiconductors, and Robotics

segments.tr: ## Overview of the Initial Budget Request

segments.src: 経済産業省は、令和8年度(2026年度)予算の概算要求において、一般会計と特別会計を合わせて約7.7兆円規模の要求をまとめたとみられます。概算要求は各省庁が来年度に必要と見込む予算を財務省に提示する段階のものであり、この時点での金額はあくまで「要望額」です。実際の予算規模や配分は、年末にかけての予算編成過程や国会審議を経て最終的に決まる点に留意が必要です。
segments.tr: The Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) has compiled an initial budget request for FY2026 totaling approximately 7.7 trillion yen, combining the general account and special accounts. An initial budget request is the stage at which each ministry presents to the Ministry of Finance the budget it expects to need for the following fiscal year, and the figures at this point are merely "requested amounts." It is important to note that the actual budget size and allocation will be finalized through the budget formulation process in the lead-up to year-end and subsequent deliberation by the Diet.
## Approximately 4.5 Trillion Yen in Growth Investment Framework

segments.src: 今回の要求で特に注目されるのが、AI(人工知能)や半導体、ロボットといった分野を対象とした、いわゆる「青天井」型の成長投資枠です。この枠には約4.5兆円が計上されたとされ、経済安全保障や産業競争力の強化を見据えた大型投資として位置づけられています。「青天井」という表現は、通常の予算のように上限をあらかじめ固定するのではなく、必要性に応じて柔軟に積み増しを可能にする仕組みを指すとみられますが、実際の運用方法や執行の仕組みについては今後の予算編成過程で明らかになっていく見通しです。
segments.tr: Particularly noteworthy in this request is the so-called "unlimited ceiling" growth investment framework targeting fields such as AI (artificial intelligence), semiconductors, and robotics. This framework is reportedly allocated approximately 4.5 trillion yen and is positioned as a major investment aimed at strengthening economic security and industrial competitiveness. The term "unlimited ceiling" refers to a mechanism that, unlike conventional budgets where an upper limit is fixed in advance, allows for flexible increases according to necessity. However, the actual operational methods and implementation mechanisms are expected to become clearer through the budget formulation process that lies ahead.

segments.src: ## ロボット・フィジカルAI分野に約1.4兆円
segments.tr: ## Approximately 1.4 Trillion Yen for Robotics and Physical AI

segments.src: 成長投資枠のうち、いわゆる「フィジカルAI」やロボット分野には約1.4兆円が振り向けられる方針とされています。フィジカルAIとは、画像認識や言語処理など情報空間で完結するAIとは異なり、センサーやロボットアームなどを通じて実世界の物理的な作業に応用されるAI技術を指す言葉として近年使われるようになっています。製造業の自動化や人手不足対応、災害対応ロボットなど幅広い応用が期待される分野であり、今回の要求はこうした技術開発を後押しする狙いがあるとみられます。
segments.tr: Within the growth investment framework, approximately 1.4 trillion yen is reportedly being directed toward the so-called "Physical AI" and robotics sectors. Physical AI, as the term has increasingly been used in recent years, refers to AI technology applied to physical tasks in the real world through sensors and robotic arms, distinguishing it from AI that operates entirely in the information space, such as image recognition or natural language processing. This is a field with broad applications expected—including manufacturing automation, addressing labor shortages, and disaster response robots—and the current request appears aimed at supporting such technological development.

segments.src: ## 半導体・AI投資の位置づけ
segments.tr: ## Positioning of Semiconductor and AI Investments

segments.src: 半導体分野については、国内の生産基盤強化や先端技術の開発支援など、これまでの政策の延長線上にある投資が中心になるとみられます。AI分野についても、基盤モデルの開発支援や計算資源(GPUなど)の整備、人材育成といった施策が引き続き重視される可能性があります。ただし、具体的な事業ごとの配分額や対象企業・分野の詳細については、現時点で公表されている情報だけでは全容を把握しきれない部分もあり、今後公表される資料や予算編成の進捗を注視する必要があります。
segments.tr: In the semiconductor sector, investments are expected to center on strengthening domestic production bases and supporting advanced technology development—essentially continuing existing policies. In the AI sector as well, measures such as supporting foundation model development, securing computational resources (such as GPUs), and developing talent are likely to continue receiving emphasis. However, regarding the specific allocation amounts for individual projects and details on target companies and sectors, the information currently disclosed does not provide a complete picture. It is necessary to carefully monitor materials to be released in the future and progress in the budget formulation process.

segments.src: 概算要求はあくまで各省庁の「要求」段階であり、財務省による査定や年末の予算編成を経て、最終的な予算案は年明けの通常国会に提出される流れが一般的です。したがって、今回まとめられた7.7兆円という数字や、AI・半導体・ロボット分野への重点配分方針も、今後の調整により変更される可能性があります。今回の要求内容は、日本政府がAIやロボットといった先端技術分野への投資を引き続き重要政策と位置づけていることを示すものといえますが、実際の予算成立まで継続的に動向を確認していくことが重要です。
segments.tr: An initial budget request is, at its core, a "request" stage by each ministry, and the typical flow has the final budget bill submitted to the regular Diet session at the start of the new year following examination by the Ministry of Finance and budget formulation at year-end. Consequently, the 7.7 trillion yen figure compiled this time and the policy of prioritizing allocation to AI, semiconductors, and robotics sectors may be subject to change through future adjustments. While the content of this request demonstrates that the Japanese government continues to position investment in advanced technology fields such as AI and robotics as important policy, it is crucial to continuously monitor developments until the budget is formally enacted.

segments.src: *本記事は概算要求の段階で伝えられている内容を基にまとめたものであり、最終的な予算内容とは異なる場合があります。正式な予算については、財務省・経済産業省の公表資料をご確認ください。*
segments.tr: *This article is based on information disclosed at the initial budget request stage and may differ from the final budget details. For the official budget, please confirm the materials released by the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry.*
